description: Set (or overwrite) a custom field's value on a task. The `value` shape depends on the field type (text/number primitive, drop_down option id, labels array, date epoch ms, users array). Look up the type with a get_*_custom_fields tool first.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true to treat `task_id` as a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

task_id.description: ID of the task to set the field on.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

value.description: Value to set, in the shape required by the field's type (see the tool description).

value_options.description: Optional extra options for the value, e.g. { time: true } to include a time component for date fields.

name: set_task_custom_field_value
